Your cheeks are beautiful with earrings, your neck with strings of jewels.
He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

translations.web: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, in its front.
translations.bsb: and they fastened the other ends of the two chains to the two filigree settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.
translations.kjv: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.
translations.asv: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, in the forepart thereof.
